name: Naltrexone
description: Opioid antagonist that blocks the brain's opioid receptors; for weight, approved only with bupropion

note.text: For weight, FDA approved naltrexone only combined with bupropion, as Contrave (2014).

bullets: **Blocks opioid receptors,** so opioids taken while on it have little effect
**With bupropion,** lab and animal data point to the hypothalamus and reward system
**In lab studies,** the pair raised firing of appetite-regulating POMC cells
**Contrave label:** the exact effects behind weight loss are not fully understood
Dose-finding trial vs naltrexone alone: 419 adults

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak within 1 hour; main metabolite 6-β-naltrexol; kidney excretion
practical.monitored: Liver injury signs; mood and suicidal thoughts (Contrave)

regulatory.text: Mysimba: heart safety past 12 months uncertain

references: FDA, Naltrexone hydrochloride tablets prescribing information, Sep 2026
Nissen et al., LIGHT trial, JAMA, Mar 2016
